nasa_apod.title: Starry Night II
nasa_apod.explanation: Does this scene look familiar? It is a modern recreation of the famous painting Starry Night by Vincent van Gogh.  Both the image and the painting depict a tall tree on the left, a crescent moon on the upper right, the planet Venus just to the right of the tree, a foreground horizon rising from left...
